unsupported: Komplete Packaging Service, operating as KPAK, is a contract packaging company headquartered in Grand Prairie, Texas, with a second facility in Arlington.
The business was founded in 1991 as a small co-packer handling hand-pack work before expanding into automated packaging lines.
KPAK also offers blending, fulfillment, and frozen and refrigerated warehousing to support end-to-end supply chain needs.
Its customer base spans cosmetics, skincare and food manufacturers seeking co-packing and contract packaging solutions.
KPAK emphasizes its SQF certification and recognition from the American Institute of Baking as markers of its quality and food-safety systems.

Known for: 175 packaging machines across 230,000 sq ft of production space; Frozen and refrigerated warehousing on site; Blending and fulfillment services integrated with packaging; SQF certified with American Institute of Baking recognition; Serves cosmetics, skincare and food sectors
